```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(Biostrings))
library(cubar)
library(tidyverse)

yeast_cds_qc <- check_cds(yeast_cds)
yeast_cds_qc

yeast_half_life <- as_tibble(yeast_half_life)
yeast_half_life

# merge expression levels and half lives 
yeast_exp2 <- yeast_exp |> 
    full_join(yeast_half_life[c('gene_id', 'half_life')], by = join_by(gene_id)) |> 
    filter(gene_id %in% names(yeast_cds_qc), fpkm >= 1) |> 
    mutate(len = width(yeast_cds[gene_id]),
           len_qc = width(yeast_cds_qc[gene_id]))

yeast_cds_qc <- yeast_cds_qc[names(yeast_cds_qc) %in% yeast_exp2$gene_id]
yeast_cds_qc <- yeast_cds_qc[yeast_exp2$gene_id]
yeast_cf <- count_codons(yeast_cds_qc)
```

# sliding-window
```{r}
# get tRNA weights
yeast_trna_w <- est_trna_weight(yeast_trna_gcn)
```


## longest genes
```{r}
# top 1000 longest genes
tmp_long <- yeast_exp2 |> slice_max(len, n = 1000)

yeast_long_swa <- lapply(yeast_cds_qc[tmp_long$gene_id], function(x){
    slide_apply(x, get_tai, step = 3, before = 2, after = 2, trna_w = yeast_trna_w)
})
yeast_long_swa <- bind_rows(yeast_long_swa, .id = 'gene_id')

plt <- yeast_long_swa |>
       filter(end <= 4500, center >= 150)  # exclude the first 50 codons
ggplot(plt, aes(x = (center + 2) %/% 3, y = index, group = center)) +
    geom_boxplot()

plt2 <- plt |> 
    summarise(index = median(index), .by = c(start, center, end))

ggplot(plt2, aes(x = center %/% 3, y = index)) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_line() +
    geom_smooth(se = FALSE) +
    labs(x = 'Codon distance', y = 'Window tAI') +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(axis.text = element_text(color = 'black')) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(50, 500, 1000, 1500)) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(50, 1525), expand = FALSE)

ggsave('figures/sliding_window_longest_genes.pdf', width = 4, height = 3)

yeast_long_swa_stat <- yeast_long_swa |> 
    summarize(
        corr = cor(center, index),
        pval = cor.test(center, index)$p.value,
        .by = c(gene_id))

tmp <- yeast_cds_qc[['YKL182W']] |> 
    slide_apply(get_tai, step = 10, before = 10, after = 10, trna_w = yeast_trna_w)

ggplot(tmp, aes(x = center %/% 3, y = index)) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_line() +
    geom_smooth(method = 'lm', se = FALSE) +
    labs(x = 'Codon position', y = 'Window tAI') +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(axis.text = element_text(color = 'black')) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(50, 500, 1000, 1500, 2000)) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(50, max(tmp$center %/% 3)+25), expand = FALSE)
ggsave('figures/sliding_window_longest_genes_example.pdf', width = 4, height = 3)

cor.test(tmp$center, tmp$index)
# p-value = 3.759e-12, corr = 0.4624482

# check trend approaching stop codons;
# not idea since last windows are not aligned
plt3 <- yeast_long_swa |> 
    left_join(tmp_long[c('gene_id', 'len_qc')], by = join_by(gene_id)) |> 
    mutate(across(c(start, center, end), ~ .x - len_qc - 1)) |> 
    filter(start >= -3000) |> 
    summarise(index = median(index), .by = c(start, center, end)) |> 
    as_tibble()

ggplot(plt3, aes(x = center %/% 3, y = index)) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_line() +
    geom_smooth() +
    labs(x = 'Codon position', y = 'Window tAI') +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(axis.text = element_text(color = 'black'))

```


## Codon ramp
```{r}

# only keep genes with at least 150 codons
tmp_c100 <- yeast_exp2 |> filter(len_qc >= 450)

# all genes
yeast_all_swa <- lapply(yeast_cds_qc[tmp_c100$gene_id], function(x){
    slide_apply(x, get_tai, step = 3, before = 2, after = 2, trna_w = yeast_trna_w)
})
yeast_all_swa <- bind_rows(yeast_all_swa, .id = 'gene_id')

plt <- yeast_all_swa |> filter(end <= 450)
ggplot(plt, aes(x = (center + 2) %/% 3, y = index, group = center)) +
    geom_boxplot()

plt2 <- plt |> 
    summarise(index = median(index), .by = c(start, center, end))

# weak trends of codon ramp at 5'end
# see also: https://elifesciences.org/articles/89656
ggplot(plt2, aes(x = center %/% 3, y = index)) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_line() +
    labs(x = 'Codon position', y = 'Window tAI') +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(axis.text = element_text(color = 'black'))
ggsave('figures/sliding_window_codom_ramp.pdf', width = 4, height = 3)

yeast_all_swa_stat <- yeast_all_swa |> 
    filter(center >= 150) |>  # exclude the first 50 codons
    summarize(
        corr = cor(center, index),
        pval = cor.test(center, index)$p.value,
        .by = c(gene_id)) |> 
    as_tibble() |> 
    left_join(yeast_exp2, by = join_by(gene_id))

yeast_all_swa_stat

ggplot(yeast_all_swa_stat, aes(x = corr)) +
    geom_histogram(fill = 'lightgrey') +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = 'black') +
    labs(x = 'Window postion-tAI correlation', y = 'Number of genes') +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(axis.text = element_text(color = 'black'))
ggsave('figures/sliding_window_trends_exclude_first50.pdf', width = 4, height = 3)
# Wilcoxon signed-rank test
wilcox.test(yeast_all_swa_stat$corr, alternative = "greater", mu = 0)$p.value # 1.484992e-72

tmp <- yeast_cds_qc[['YBR084C-A']] |> 
    slide_apply(get_tai, step = 3, before = 2, after = 2, trna_w = yeast_trna_w)

ggplot(tmp, aes(x = center %/% 3, y = index)) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_line() +
    geom_smooth(method = 'lm', se = FALSE) +
    labs(x = 'Codon position', y = 'Window tAI') +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(axis.text = element_text(color = 'black')) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(50, 100, 150)) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(50, max(tmp$center %/% 3)+5), expand = FALSE)
ggsave('figures/sliding_trends_example.pdf', width = 4, height = 3)

cor.test(tmp$center, tmp$index)
# corr = 0.5616469, p-value = 2.04e-06
```

GO analysis
```{r}
library(org.Sc.sgd.db)
library(clusterProfiler)

sigpos <- yeast_all_swa_stat |> 
    mutate(padj = p.adjust(pval, method = 'BH')) |> 
    filter(corr > 0, padj < 0.05)

sigpos_goa <- enrichGO(sigpos$gene_id, org.Sc.sgd.db, keyType = 'ORF', ont = 'ALL', qvalueCutoff = 0.05)
sigpos_goa <- simplify(sigpos_goa)
# only 15 significant categories

enrichplot::dotplot(sigpos_goa, showCategory = 20) + theme_bw(base_size = 12)
ggsave('figures/sliding_trends_GO.pdf', width = 6, height = 6)
```


misc tests
```{r}
cor.test(yeast_all_swa_stat$corr, yeast_all_swa_stat$fpkm, method = 'spearman')
cor.test(yeast_all_swa_stat$corr, yeast_all_swa_stat$len_qc, method = 'spearman')

yeast_all_swa_stat2 <- yeast_all_swa_stat |> 
    mutate(
        gfpkm = cut_number(fpkm, n = 3),
        glen = cut_number(len_qc, n = 3))

ggplot(yeast_all_swa_stat2, aes(y = gfpkm, x = corr)) +
    ggridges::geom_density_ridges(quantile_lines = TRUE, quantiles = 2)

ggplot(yeast_all_swa_stat2, aes(y = gfpkm, x = corr)) +
    ggridges::geom_density_ridges(quantile_lines = TRUE, quantiles = 2) +
    facet_wrap(vars(glen))

ggplot(yeast_all_swa_stat2, aes(y = glen, x = corr)) +
    ggridges::geom_density_ridges(quantile_lines = TRUE, quantiles = 2) +
    facet_wrap(vars(gfpkm))

yeast_all_swa_stat
```
